motivation: v5 failed because all predeclared pair-regime feature signs were opposite to their frozen semantics. The strongest post-result diagnostic was the sign-reversed 21-day pair-trend feature, suggesting trend exhaustion: when an extreme adaptive gold/silver dislocation extends the established pair trend, mean reversion may be more likely; when the dislocation runs against that trend, continuation may be more likely. v6 freezes that single hypothesis and tests it only on the separate 2021-2023 period. This is retrospective temporal validation, not future OOS.

pair_model.type: recursive least squares on log(gold_close) = alpha + beta * log(silver_close)
pair_model.rationale: fixed from the strongest v3 state hypothesis, not selected using 2021-2023 outcomes

feature.name: trend_exhaustion_support_21
feature.definition: positive sign(event_z) times the causally standardized trailing 21-trading-day beta-normalized pair close return; positive means the established pair trend runs in the same direction as the current extreme dislocation and therefore supports exhaustion/mean reversion
feature.origin: sign reversal was generated only after v5 completed; v5 development data cannot count as confirmation

state_test.target: mean-reversion payoff state: -sign(event_z) times future 21-trading-day beta-normalized hedged pair close return using signal-time beta

economic_translation.direction: score > 0 => mean reversion side (-sign event_z); score < 0 => continuation side (+sign event_z)
economic_translation.entry: next common daily open after completed signal close
economic_translation.exit: common daily open after 21 trading bars

decision.on_pass: freeze for prospective shadow only; no leverage or live trading until genuine future OOS exists
decision.on_fail: close trend-exhaustion hypothesis and move to structurally orthogonal gold event research
